notes: Precommitted before any inference (IAC-396 run 1). Labels are not changed after a run: a disputed label is reported, never edited. Organizations and vendors are invented. Every expected label is written from the category definitions in src/ai/categories.ts, and a line that is genuinely ambiguous under those definitions is expected UNKNOWN. A rejected, errored or missing answer never counts as a correct UNKNOWN. No claim of general receipt accuracy.
